description: A view-only link to watch a run live and read its result, with no sign-in, valid while it runs and for some hours after. Runs started here get one automatically; this makes another, or one for a run started from the web app. The link shows the live screen, the steps and checks so far, then the read-only result. membersOnly is true when the workspace limits watch links to signed-in members (or the run came from a public repository). 403 when the workspace turned watch links off. Reference: https://testsy.dev/docs/mcp/
name: create_watch_link
title: Create a watch link
